instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Croatian tweet convey, judged from its tone and from the valence of what it reports or shares?
instructions.rule: Negative needs the poster to be bothered or attacking: their own complaint, mishap or suffering (even joked about), annoyance, sarcasm aimed at someone, moralising, or news of something bad (crisis, debt, conflict, criticism, accusation, lawsuit, death, scandal). Deadpan observations about others, banter, calm opinions, statistics, political or institutional events, religious texts and horoscopes are neutral. Shares of culture, entertainment, celebrities, sport, tech, business deals, article teasers, tips, ads and listings (apartments, shops, products), check-ins, calls to help and warm replies are positive.

neutral.what: Statistics, line-ups, quotes. Political or institutional events, debates and calm opinions. Religious texts, horoscopes. Practical how-to replies, banter, and deadpan observations about others.
examples: Mama gleda njemačku Bachelorette. Žena gleda američki Masterchef. Počinjem štedjet za treći televizor. (Mom watches German Bachelorette. My wife watches American Masterchef. I'm starting to save for a third TV.)
Ne propustite večeras debatu kandidata za predsjednika @EU_Commission @hrtvijesti http://t.co/EgGMQ2dir7 (Don't miss tonight's debate of candidates for Commission president)
neutral.cues: sabor (parliament), zastupnik (MP), sjednica (session), debata (debate), horoskop, plain questions, numbers, 'mislim da' (I think), haha
neutral.not_for: The poster's own annoyance or mishap, or news of criticism, conflict or failure, go negative. Promotional or culture shares go positive.

positive.what: Joy, praise, thanks, warmth, anticipation. Shares of events, culture, celebrities, sport, tech, business deals, article teasers, recipes and tips, ads, accommodation or shop listings, check-ins, help appeals.
examples: Pula: Na Giardinima započela 8. Florija, sajam cvijeća u sklopu obilježavanja Dana Grada: https://t.co/6Jbezcjeer (Pula: the 8th Florija flower fair started at Giardini)
Apartments Batur - Zadar - Croatia http://t.co/vLFrL36bKd http://t.co/05CLYU5jQL #croatia
Šol je za odreske i potrebno ga je vrlo malo pržiti. #321kuhaj (This cut is for steaks and needs very little frying)
RT @amaiia_hr: #Zagreb - Volonteri traže prijevoz do poplavljenih područja #poplave (Volunteers seek transport to flooded areas)
positive.cues: premijera (premiere), festival, ponuda (offer), apartments, pročitajte (read), kako (how to), pomozimo (let's help), hvala (thanks), I'm at, :), :D
positive.not_for: Smileys on complaints or digs go negative. Political events, religious texts and horoscopes go neutral.

negative.what: The poster complains, suffers a mishap, is annoyed, sad or worried, insults, mocks or moralises. Also news of bad things: crises, debt, conflicts, harsh criticism, accusations, lawsuits, deaths, scandals.
examples: Naravno, opet kiša u Brusselsu. (Of course, rain in Brussels again.)
Putin na presici žestoko kritizira novo ukrajinsko vodstvo: 'Vojna akcija protiv Ukrajine će biti posljednja opcija!' (Putin harshly criticizes the new Ukrainian leadership)
@LucijaCavric oho i ovdje si finjak :P (oho, you're being posh here too)
negative.cues: opet (again), jebiga (damn it), mrzim (I hate), sranje (crap), grozan (awful), kritizira (criticizes), postupak protiv (proceedings against), dug (debt), :(, :S
negative.not_for: Help appeals go positive. Witty observations about others and calm opinions go neutral.
